sharedTextureReadback.deployment: opt-in selected process, measured activation, main-process preflight only
sharedTextureReadback.scope: raw GPU blit followed by CPU copy; compressed/depth/unknown formats and other texture kinds remain native

gravityMark.adapter: binding tables plus measured shared-texture readback adapter
gravityMark.causalityLimit: Two populated-scene completions, but identical-adapter and activation repeats can be black. Only constructor preflight copies were counted. Neither readback interception nor foregrounding explains or fixes this reliably.
gravityMark.bindingOnlyConfirmation: black scene and zero visible objects reproduced; reject its score
remaining: heap allocation requests return nil and the benchmark falls back
pixel equivalence to native Metal is unaudited
gravityMark.sameAdapterRepeat: exit 0 but black scene / zero visible objects; reject reported 101.9 fps / score 17017
gravityMark.activationRepeat: exit 0 but black/visible=0 again; reject 98.4 fps / score16441; foregrounding alone is not a fix

additionalBenchmark.correctionReason: Column-major perspective matrix had its -1 and nearZ*zs entries transposed. At camera-space z=-2.5, old clip z/w is about 6; corrected is about 0.961, inside Metal's [0,1] depth range.
additionalBenchmark.limits: Source-corrected benchmark, not an untouched upstream score. Resolution differs from GravityMark; do not compare their fps as equivalent workloads. Frame scheduling is near 160 fps, not proof of GPU saturation. Native M4 GUI reference timed out before drawing; no M4 reference score is claimed.
